gaps.title: Unified Engineering Identity Contract
gaps.description: Establish a unified CanonicalEngineeringIdentity interface supporting canonicalEntityId, domainId, canonicalRevisionId, parentRevisionId, geometryHash, topologyHash, engineeringStateHash, dependencyManifest, and authorityReference.
gaps.remediationPlan: Extend CanonicalEngineeringIdentity and EngineeringIdentityFactory to provide deterministic identity minting across all 7 engineering domains.

gaps.title: Canonical Domain Binding Layer
gaps.description: Implement explicit binding handlers (PcbToCoreBinding, ElectricalToCoreBinding, HarnessToCoreBinding, FemToCoreBinding, CfdToCoreBinding, MultidomainToCoreBinding) that validate canonical references.
gaps.remediationPlan: Create CanonicalDomainBindingEngine to prove model lineage, source revision, and active validity status before computation.

gaps.title: Cross-Domain Dependency & Revision Propagation
gaps.description: Construct a verified CrossDomainDependencyGraph with selective recompute, stale result detection, and dependency invalidation pipeline.
gaps.remediationPlan: Integrate CrossDomainDependencyGraph into InvalidationPipelineEngine to invalidate downstream FEM, CFD, and Multidomain results when upstream PCB/MCAD mutates.

gaps.title: Cross-Domain Engineering Consistency Verifier
gaps.description: Implement automated consistency checking across PCB vs Electrical components/nets, Electrical vs Harness connectors/wires, Harness vs MCAD routes, and Thermal vs FEM/CFD material models.
gaps.remediationPlan: Build CrossDomainConsistencyEngine enforcing identity, topological, geometric, physical, and functional compatibility.

gaps.title: Simulation Input Authority & Seal Verification
gaps.description: Enforce mandatory SimulationRunManifest containing simulationRunId, canonicalRevisionId, domainRevisionBindings, geometryHash, topologyHash, materialModelHash, boundaryConditionHash, meshHash, solverConfigurationHash, solverVersion, inputManifestHash, and executionAuthority for all FEM and CFD runs.
gaps.remediationPlan: Bind FEMCore and Fvm3DNavierStokesSolver to SimulationAuthorityInternal sealEnvelope and verifyEnvelopeSeal before execution.

gaps.title: Multidomain Coupling & Feedback Loops
gaps.description: Establish multi-directional coupling feedback loops (PCB geometry shift -> electrothermal -> harness length -> FEM stress -> CFD cooling) with explicit coupling classification.
gaps.remediationPlan: Upgrade MultidomainPcbIntegrationEngine to track multidomain execution state, invalidate stale couplings, and trigger selective recomputation.

gaps.title: Canonical Evidence Continuity
gaps.description: Bind every execution, simulation, and integration run to immutable SHA-256 evidence roots in EvidenceBus, PLMProjectionAdapter, and EngineeringObjectOS.
gaps.remediationPlan: Unify EvidenceBus and AttestationCanonicalizer to generate tamper-evident, revision-bound evidence manifests.

gaps.title: UI-to-Core Truth Enforcement
gaps.description: Audit all workbench UI components to ensure state is read strictly from canonical Core, local shadow state is forbidden, and stale results are clearly flagged.
gaps.remediationPlan: Enforce InvalidationPipelineEngine lifecycle states (CURRENT, STALE, INVALID) across all workbench UI panels.
